xdm:skills.title: Skills
xdm:skills.description: Full, ordered list of skill invocations for this experience, across all agents. Each entry records the skill that was called, why it was called (xdm:reasoning), the optional agent it was executed under (xdm:agentID), and ordering/de-duplication keys for downstream blending (xdm:skillInvocationID, xdm:timestamp). Replaces the deprecated per-agent xdm:agents[].xdm:skills array.

xdm:skillID.title: Skill ID
xdm:skillID.description: Identifier of the skill definition that was called.

xdm:skillInvocationID.title: Skill Invocation ID
xdm:skillInvocationID.description: Unique identifier for this individual skill invocation, consistent even with redeliveries of the same call. Intended as the de-duplication key when merging skill arrays downstream.

xdm:name.title: Skill Name
xdm:name.description: Name of the skill that was called

xdm:version.title: Skill Version
xdm:version.description: Version of the skill that was called

xdm:agentID.title: Agent ID
xdm:agentID.description: Identifier of the agent that invoked this skill, correlating to xdm:agents[].xdm:agentID. Populated with the invoking agent: the root/orchestrator agent for main-loop skills, or the subagent for skills invoked by a subagent. Because subagents run in parallel, this is the grouping key consumers use to order skills within an agent.

xdm:invocationSource.title: Invocation Source
xdm:invocationSource.description: Whether this skill was invoked by the main agentic loop or by a subagent

meta:enum.main: Invoked by the harness main agentic loop

xdm:score.title: Skill Matching Score
xdm:score.description: Score resulting from matching the skill

xdm:failed.title: Skill Failed
xdm:failed.description: Flag stating that the skill execution failed

xdm:sequenceNumber.title: Skill Sequence Number
xdm:sequenceNumber.description: Monotonically increasing index of this skill call within a single agent execution — not turn-global, since subagents run in parallel. Ordering: consumers group by xdm:agentID, then order within each group by xdm:sequenceNumber, then xdm:timestamp as tiebreaker and fallback. Optional — populated when the producer can emit a per-execution counter

xdm:timestamp.title: Skill Timestamp
xdm:timestamp.description: Time the skill was invoked, ISO 8601 UTC. Ordering key used after xdm:sequenceNumber (consumers order by sequenceNumber, then timestamp). Producers should always populate this; the requirement is enforced by convention rather than a hard schema constraint so partially-instrumented producers are not dropped at ingestion.

xdm:skillSource.title: Skill Source
xdm:skillSource.description: How the skill definition was delivered to the runtime

meta:enum.inline: Skill content loaded inline into the current context
meta:enum.deferred: Skill content loaded on demand / deferred

xdm:executionContext.title: Execution Context
xdm:executionContext.description: Where the skill executes relative to the calling agent

meta:enum.inline: Runs inline in the calling agent's context
meta:enum.forked: Runs in a forked sub-agent context

xdm:narration.title: Reasoning Narration
xdm:narration.description: Natural-language explanation of why this skill was called.

xdm:parameters.title: Skill Parameters
xdm:parameters.description: Parameters passed in to the skill
